summary: VEON Ltd., a Dubai-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the nine- and three-month periods ended September 30, 2026. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly earnings release equivalent to a US issuer's periodic report. Reported figures include nine-month revenue of $3,779 million, operating profit of $1,060 million and profit attributable to owners of $408 million, alongside a $162 million listing expense and a $50 million gain on disposal of subsidiaries. There is no deal to arbitrage; attention falls on segment trends, leverage and disposal accounting.
